Publication-ready figures. figure draws title, subtitle caption canvas; carries axes legend placed outside data, every reference line colour code legend. Figures written <title>.png (clock id appended per-clock figures) <title>.txt beside holding title, figure’s numbers description. save_figure() figure_text() figure, Python R; reports caption figure text link .txt. falconage demo: pipeline small synthetic dataset, every output can seen real data ready. fa.demo_data() returns dataset. catalogue 68 human clocks (62 DNA methylation, 4 clinical chemistry, 2 NMR), every one shipping coefficients scoring offline, traced primary source. coverage map drawn clock scored: one genome track per clock, CpGs hg19 positions, coloured data carries grey , legend giving clock’s colour coverage. includes clocks add, shows CpGs clocks share, switched (fa.plot.clock_coverage_manhattan, R plot_clock_coverage()). Uncertainty every score: technical_se() propagates published per-probe reliability clock’s weights; conformal_interval() gives distribution-free prediction intervals; icc_from_replicates() variance_components() measure reliability user’s replicates. Analysis: age acceleration three conventions, gated clock’s scale type; association Cox models; AA1/AA2 benchmark; consensus(), asks whether group difference holds across clocks; power() detectable_effect() study design. Clinical clocks: PhenoAge, Klemera-Doubal homeostatic dysregulation reproducing BioAge, LinAge2, MetaboAge MetaboHealth. Building clock. fa.fit_clock() fits elastic net reproducing glmnet, eight learners, every reported prediction made fold, folds optionally grouped person batch, Horvath’s age transform request, MAE, MedAE, r, slope bias thirds. fa.compare_learners() compares learners folds reports nested error picking best one. elastic net solver now uses glmnet’s active-set strategy ridge closed form, wide arrays fit reasonable time unchanged answers.
